title: exapump
tagline: The kit's SQL and bulk-load CLI.
role: exapump runs SQL against the local database and bulk-loads CSV and Parquet files into tables. The kit installs it and writes a connection profile called starter-kit.
warning: The starter-kit profile connects as the ADMIN user and is NOT sandboxed: it can create, drop and delete. Never treat an exapump success as proof something is safe for the MCP path, and never reach for exapump to work around an MCP rejection.

commands.description: Runs a single statement through a saved connection profile and prints the result.
examples: exapump sql -p starter-kit 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TPCH.NATION'

commands.description: Feeds a script in over stdin, which also keeps statements off the process table.
Loads a CSV or Parquet file into a table. JSON is not an exapump input - use exakit data-load, which shreds it into tables first.

commands.summary: Create or update a connection profile.
commands.description: Prompts for host, port, user and password and writes them into the config file (mode 600).

environment.name: EXAPUMP_CONFIG
environment.effect: Override the config path. Profiles live in ~/.exapump/config.toml by default.

troubleshooting.remedy: The database is not running: exakit start, then exakit status.
Exasol does not page with FETCH FIRST or TOP. Use LIMIT <n>, optionally with OFFSET.
Wrong name or a missing schema qualifier. DESCRIBE <schema>.<table> first, then fix the query.
